verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Temporal as Workflows-as-Code, meaning any data handling between steps is ordinary developer code in SDK Workflow Definitions. Nothing documents an expression, function, or formula feature for mapping or transforming data between steps. General-purpose SDK code is a developer building block, not a documented data-mapping capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map and transform data between steps with expressions, functions, or formulas
